events.title: Codex supervisor (interactive): HOLD
events.detail: All five qualifying QC channels passed, but S-003 documented independent pH below 6.8 and S-004 confirmed a substantial historical instrument bias. Recovery and passing endpoint assays do not resolve that earlier exposure. Recommend HOLD under SIM-EXP-001, with the excursion and uncertainty retained for investigation.

request.rationale: The last metabolic evidence is from 26 h. The transient online pH rise near 36 h warrants an independent reference check; obtain current metabolism and reference pH before changing the controller.

S-004 demonstrates a +0.28 pH bias, and S-003 confirms an adverse independent pH. Correct the instrument using the fresh check. Increase perfusion moderately as biomass and lactate rise. Preserve a hold for the earlier exposure; recovery will not erase it.
Online pH has recovered after calibration. Obtain independent sampled pH and viability to confirm recovery, while retaining the documented 48 h excursion and the batch hold.
The independent pH has recovered and the valid glucose/lactate sample supports continuing 6 mL/h. Retain the historical hold and reassess metabolism after twelve hours.
Scheduled reassessment of independent pH, recovery and metabolism after fourteen hours since the last collection.
The recovering culture has grown to 1.9188 million viable cells/mL and lactate continues to rise. Increase dilution to 10 mL/h within the remaining medium budget, preserving the earlier history hold.
Collect current independent pH, viability and metabolites before the final culture interval. Earlier sensor history still precludes acceptance.

Glucose remains ample, but increasing biomass will raise metabolite production. Use the permitted dilution maximum through the final interval and collect QC at 118 h so evidence is close to the 120 h endpoint. The historical pH issue remains a hold.

Collect the full qualifying banking panel and a near-endpoint metabolic sample at 118 h. Final current quality is distinct from the earlier pH excursion; acceptance remains unsupported even if current assays pass.

Culture has ended. Viability is valid and currently above the project minimum, but identity, phenotype, genomic and microbial evidence remain pending. Wait through the longest assay delay; retain the historical process hold.
